objective: Preallocate query-source table buffers during statement permission resolution.

tasks.title: Preallocate permission query table buffers
tasks.result: Statement permission resolution now reserves query-source table buffers from the SELECT/COPY/CREATE VIEW AST shape.

notes: Cargo/linker verification used an E: workspace temp directory because the default C:/TEMP drive was previously full.
The table capacity estimate mirrors collect_query_tables for table and derived-table factors.
The change preserves collected table order and permission tuple construction.
